tasks.task: Plan the page list and section-by-section build sheet

items.when: Before any layout, to settle what the business says before how the site looks
When the page list is open, to get a page tree, menu, URLs and internal links
When a 5 to 10 page site needs each section planned in the builder's own block names
Before you settle a page layout, to get three alternatives to the template's default
When the home page talks about the firm and not the visitor's problem
When the menu and buttons are drafted, to rate each label and rewrite the unclear ones
When a page is laid out, to check hierarchy, spacing, contrast and the phone view

tasks.task: Write the words for each section so they fit the blocks

items.when: Before writing, to frame the message with the customer as the hero
When the build sheet is agreed and each headline, button and card needs words that fit
When the top of the home page is undecided, to compare five headlines with a subhead
When a whole page needs its headline, sections and calls to action drafted
When the client has real customer questions and the site needs an FAQ page
When a line could be on any firm's site, to test it and get a true, picturable rewrite

tasks.task: Set the site's fonts, colours and style settings

items.when: When the client points to a site they like, to read its colours, fonts and layout rules
When there are no brand fonts, to compare three pairs with sizes and line spacing
When the brand has one colour or none, to get a small palette with one job per colour
When the choices are made, to save colours, fonts and style once for every page
When the site uses many sizes and weights and nothing leads the eye
Before the styles are set in the builder, to test every text and background pair

tasks.task: Show clearly different design directions for the site

items.when: When the client shares sites they like, to turn them into a look you can name and reuse
When the copy is ready, to get three on-brand designs for a key page and a build brief
When one option should be bold, with motion and layout that push past the template
When the client must see a real page in the chosen look before the builder work starts
When every option is the template with new colours
When a direction is drafted, to check it still reads well on a phone

tasks.task: Plan the CMS collections for a blog or case studies

items.when: When a site needs collections, fields, links between them and template pages planned
When one template will make many pages, such as locations or services, from data
When the case study collection needs its first entries written from project notes
When collection pages need structured data added to the template

tasks.task: Write a custom CSS or code-injection snippet

items.when: When the builder's own settings cannot do the job and a small snippet is the only way
When the snippet is a small timed or scroll animation the builder lacks
When the snippet changes spacing or type, to catch slips it causes elsewhere
When the snippet hides, moves or restyles content, to check it still works by keyboard

tasks.task: Add or rebuild a page inside an existing site

items.when: Before designing, to pull the live site's colours, fonts and spacing so the page matches
When a new page must look like the rest of the site, not like a fresh template
When the page could be laid out several ways within the site's existing blocks
After the page is added, to check forms, titles, phone layout and links

tasks.task: Build a landing page on the client's site

items.when: When you have the offer and audience and need the page plan and strict design rules
When the page needs hero, value points, proof, answers to doubts and buttons written
When the copy is done, to compare three on-brand designs before building
When the page goes into the client's builder and must match their site
When there is no builder and the page must ship as plain HTML with a working form
When the page is built, to rank conversion problems by impact with fixes

tasks.task: Run the launch check before a site goes live

items.when: Before go-live or after a big change, to check domain, forms, titles, phone layout and access
When the switch needs a runbook with cutover steps, watching and a way back
When the client has several domains and needs the records and redirects laid out
When you want a test pass across the pages with a list of problems found

tasks.task: Run a small site from brief to launch

items.when: At the start, to get goals, users, features and a page plan into one scoped brief
When a client wants a new 5 to 10 page site or a full rebuild of a template site
At the end, before the domain is pointed at the new site

tasks.task: Run an accessibility quick pass on a builder site

items.when: Before launch or after a redesign, to catch common failures with fixes in the builder
When you can point at the live page and want ranked problems with fixes
When the client needs gaps by level and notes for an accessibility statement
Each quarter, to rank new gaps and confirm last quarter's fixes held
When the site passes the checks but some visitors still cannot finish the main task

tasks.task: Choose a site builder or decide whether to move

items.when: Before comparing builders, to list what the site must do now and next year
Before a client signs up for a builder, or when they ask if they should move
When the answer is to move, to plan it so search rank and old links keep working

tasks.task: Check the cookie banner, tracking and policy pages

items.when: Before the check, to list which tags and events the site should fire and why
Before launch, after adding a tag, or when the client asks if the banner works
When the site has no privacy or cookie page, to draft one for a lawyer to review

tasks.task: Write the image spec and alt text list

items.when: Before photos are taken or chosen, or when the site's images are slow or blurry
When a photographer will shoot for the site and needs one clear brief
When files are too heavy and must load faster without looking worse
When the files are ready, to check sizes, names and alt text before upload

tasks.task: Run monthly site care

items.when: Once a month, and after a builder update, a new tag or a visitor complaint
When you want the site's quality checked on a schedule with a short fix list
Each month, to read search data and catch pages that dropped or broke
When domains or certificates may lapse, to flag leftovers and weak access

tasks.task: Set page titles, descriptions, markup and local listings

items.when: When each page needs its title, description, headings and image text fixed
When a page type needs checked markup ready to paste into the builder
When the client is a local firm and its listing and reviews matter as much as the site
When the client asks why they do not show in Google or AI answers
Before launch, to catch duplicate titles, a missing sitemap and dead-end pages

tasks.task: Move a site to a new builder without losing traffic

items.when: Before the move, to mark each old page keep, update, merge, redirect or delete
When you plan the move so rank, links and bookmarks keep working
When several domains are involved and each needs its redirect decided
After the move, to find pages that dropped out of search and why

tasks.task: Fix a slow or jumpy site

items.when: When the client pastes a speed report and wants to know what it means
When you have the report and need the fixes in ordered batches
When the page jumps as it loads and you must find the element that moves
When oversized images are the cause and each block needs a size limit

tasks.task: Plan contact forms and a booking page

items.when: When a form needs its fields, error messages and spam protection planned
When an enquiry form is long, to compare a staged version
When visitors should book a call or visit, with qualifying questions and follow-up
Before launch, to send a test through every form and confirm where it lands

tasks.task: Review a live site and rank the fixes

items.when: When the client asks what is wrong with the site, to rank fixes with evidence
When a key page or form confuses people, to score it and list each break
When you want to see what a first-time visitor thinks at each scroll
When visitors must stop and think to find the one thing they came for

tasks.task: Scope and quote a website project

items.when: When the request is vague, to pin down goals, features and pages before pricing
When a brief must become a quote with scope, price assumptions and contract risks

always.when: Before any page that must match the client's live site: colours, fonts and voice
When page copy states a number, award or claim you cannot trace to the client
Before copy goes into the builder, to catch typos and names spelt two ways

helpers.when: When a sales or landing page needs more than block-length copy
When the site depends on search and needs keyword research and a content plan
When the client has no logo, palette or fonts to build the site on
When the site is large and its structure and menus need testing with users
When the job needs more custom code than a small snippet in the builder
When the site needs new photos planned and a consistent photo style

No library item checks a cookie banner: whether tags wait for consent and whether refusing is as easy as accepting
No library item shows two or three home page directions as pictures or inside the builder for a client to choose from
No library item plans a service firm's home page section by section; the layout planners are built for stores and ads
No library item writes a handover guide that teaches a client to edit their own site
No library item sets image sizes, crops and focal points for each block of a builder template
